verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a CLI and a REST API for automating installation, configuration, connection, and data retrieval. Nothing shows a built-in way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows; any recurring execution would need an external scheduler, which is a developer building block or user-side workaround and earns no credit. One-off scripted actions are not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: The AnyDesk Command-Line Interface (CLI) allows advanced users and IT administrators to automate installation, configuration, connection, and removal tasks.
